title: Grateful Dead Live at International Amphitheatre on 1973-02-19

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a prime 1973 second set highlighted by The Other One and Eyes, with only a brief dip in audio.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a strong second‑set performance from the 1973 era, with “The Other One” and “Eyes” singled out as especially compelling, and the segue He’s Gone → Truckin’ noted for its development. Audio quality is generally solid for a cassette‑sourced soundboard, though listeners report a slight dip after The Other One during the opening of Eyes. Overall the show shines despite this minor glitch.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed positive review highlights standout performances and only a small recording flaw, leading to a solid but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear cassette‑sourced soundboard; slight dip in quality after The Other One during the first verses of Eyes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A focused second‑set that builds nicely, featuring well‑developed transitions and a strong jam in Eyes.
